About the Coach

Private Coaching with Nathan Ponwith

  • ATP #367 Career High
  • #20 Junior ITF (World Tennis Zone)
  • #1 U.S. Recruit (TennisRecruiting.net)
  • D-1 College Tennis
  • ASU & University of Georgia
  • *SEC Freshman of the Year 2017

Nathan Ponwith brings an elite world-class level competitive background and years of training and coaching at the world's best tennis academies such as IMG Academy and USTA Player Development. From being #1 in the Country in USTA Boy's 12's, to #20 Junior ITF (World Tennis Zone), to compete for USA in Junior Davis cup, many national championships, to playing D-1 College tennis, to playing on the ATP tour for the last 10 years reaching a career high of #367 ATP. All of this experience is coming to the valley for every session. Whether you're a junior looking for high performance training and competition or an adult sharpening your game, improvement is waiting for you. We focus on technical stroke development, footwork training, matchplay strategy, character development, mental conditioning and physical conditioning for players at all levels. High level hitting, drilling, and matchplay is available with current ranked ATP and current UTR 13.

Private lessons and small group sessions available in the Scottsdale private training center.

Whether you are a Junior player interested in increasing your UTR with High-Performance Junior training, or an adult player looking to improve your game and have fun, precise training is ready for you.
